panels.description: Director Cassian Lock waits beside Adrian's estate record in the Halyard registry. Alex and Ada face him across the terminal; leave upper space.
Lock places a formal assignment document on the table. Keep his hands and the document clear.
The assignment document offers debt clearance and pending collaborator protection in exchange for House administration. Leave the document unobstructed.
Alex reads the listed contributors while Lock studies the record before looking at him. Leave upper space for the exchange.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: Your father’s work could clear every debt attached to your name.

ASSIGNMENT TO HOUSE ADMINISTRATION
DEBT: CLEARED
COLLABORATOR PROTECTION: PENDING

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: The people you haven’t met yet.
